subject: 🏛️ Degree Conferred — $program_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

On behalf of the Senate and the Office of the Registrar, it is our great pleasure to confirm that you have been formally approved for graduation. Your degree is conferred with effect from the date below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CONFERRAL DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:        $student_id
Programme:         $program_name
Classification:    $classification
Date of Conferral: $graduation_date
Approved By:       $approved_by

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

YOUR DOCUMENTS

  • A digital transcript will be issued to your Student Portal within 5 working days.
  • The hard-copy parchment will be presented at the graduation ceremony on $ceremony_date, or posted to your address on file if you have opted out of the ceremony.
  • A signed Statement of Award is available on request from the Registrar's Office.

NEXT STEPS

  • Confirm ceremony attendance (and any guest tickets) via the Student Portal by $rsvp_by.
  • Activate your alumni account using the link sent separately — alumni benefits include library access, career support, and event invitations.
  • Update your contact details so we can reach you for verification requests from future employers.

Thank you for everything you have brought to the University community. We are immensely proud of you — congratulations, graduate!

With warmest regards,
$approved_by
Office of the Registrar
